# A rate that works on a long run can lose money on a short one.

> Free calculator for independent ice dam removal contractors: price a job from linear feet of roof edge, crew size, an emergency/storm premium, and a minimum service charge, then check whether your per-foot rate card actually covers this job's largely fixed cost before a short call quietly loses money.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
